run_feature_extraction: run feature extraction on a video dataset using a pretrained model and save features to disk
extract_feats_model: extract features from video clips using a model, data loader, and dataset, saving results as a torch file
ef_main_args: run the full feature extraction pipeline with args including model, dataset, device, and output directory
parse_args_ef: parse command-line arguments for feature extraction including model name, batch size, and output directory
test_extract_feats: test the extract_feats function with a model, data loader, dataset, device, and args object
